## Oligos

```{r blast-guides}
guide_cmd <- sprintf(
  paste(
    'blastn -task blastn-short -query %s -subject %s',
    '-word_size 7 -evalue 1000 -dust no -soft_masking false',
    '-ungapped -perc_identity 85 -max_target_seqs 50',
    '-outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen',
    'qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore qlen slen"'
  ),
  shQuote(genomic_path), shQuote(oligo_path)
)

guide_out <- system(guide_cmd, intern = TRUE)
guide_hits <- if (length(guide_out) > 0) {
  read.table(text = guide_out, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
             col.names = col_names)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

if (nrow(guide_hits) > 0) {
  guide_hits <- merge(guide_hits, oligo_meta,
                      by.x = "Subject", by.y = "oligo_id", all.x = TRUE)
  guide_hits$strand <- ifelse(guide_hits$S.start <= guide_hits$S.end, "+", "-")
  guide_hits <- guide_hits[
    guide_hits$oligo_type == "CRISPR_guide" &
    guide_hits$Aln.Length >= (guide_hits$S.len - 2) &
    guide_hits$Identity >= 95, ]
}

cat(sprintf("Guides placed: %d\n", nrow(guide_hits)))
```

```{r epcr-primers}
# Build the hash that re-PCR queries against. famap turns the FASTA into a
# memory-mapped binary; fahash builds the lookup table on top of it.
famap_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".famap")
hash_file  <- tempfile(fileext = ".hash")
system2("famap",  c("-t", "N", "-b", famap_file, genomic_path),
        stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
system2("fahash", c("-b", hash_file, famap_file),
        stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)

oligo_seq_lookup <- setNames(
  vapply(oligo_records, function(x) x$sequence, character(1)),
  vapply(oligo_records, function(x) x$name,     character(1))
)

primer_meta <- oligo_meta[oligo_meta$oligo_type %in%
                          c("forward_primer", "reverse_primer"), ]

pair_ids <- unique(na.omit(primer_meta$pair))
sts_lines <- character(0)
pair_rows <- data.frame(
  pair = character(0), forward_id = character(0), reverse_id = character(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
for (pid in pair_ids) {
  fwd <- primer_meta[primer_meta$pair == pid &
                     primer_meta$oligo_type == "forward_primer", ]
  rev <- primer_meta[primer_meta$pair == pid &
                     primer_meta$oligo_type == "reverse_primer", ]
  if (nrow(fwd) != 1 || nrow(rev) != 1) next
  sts_lines <- c(sts_lines, sprintf("pair_%s\t%s\t%s\t100-10000",
                                     pid,
                                     oligo_seq_lookup[[fwd$oligo_id]],
                                     oligo_seq_lookup[[rev$oligo_id]]))
  pair_rows <- rbind(pair_rows, data.frame(
    pair = pid, forward_id = fwd$oligo_id, reverse_id = rev$oligo_id,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

amp_hits <- data.frame(
  seq_id = character(0), pair = character(0), strand = character(0),
  start = integer(0), end = integer(0), size = integer(0),
  forward_id = character(0), reverse_id = character(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (length(sts_lines) > 0) {
  sts_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".sts")
  writeLines(sts_lines, sts_file)
  epcr_out <- system2("re-PCR", c("-S", hash_file, sts_file),
                      stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)
  unlink(sts_file)

  data_lines <- epcr_out[!grepl("^#", epcr_out) & nzchar(epcr_out)]
  if (length(data_lines) > 0) {
    raw <- read.table(text = data_lines, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    amp_hits <- data.frame(
      seq_id = raw$V2,
      pair   = sub("^pair_", "", raw$V1),
      strand = raw$V3,
      start  = as.integer(raw$V4),
      end    = as.integer(raw$V5),
      size   = as.integer(raw$V5) - as.integer(raw$V4) + 1L,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    amp_hits <- merge(amp_hits, pair_rows, by = "pair", all.x = TRUE)
  }
}

unlink(c(famap_file, hash_file))

cat(sprintf("Predicted amplicons: %d (from %d pairs in STS)\n",
            nrow(amp_hits), nrow(pair_rows)))
```

## Annotation table

```{r build-annotation-table}
annotation <- build_annotation_table(q, meta, exon_hits, guide_hits,
                                     amp_hits, oligo_seq_lookup)
cat(sprintf("Annotation rows: %d\n", nrow(annotation)))
knitr::kable(
  with(annotation, data.frame(
    feat_type, name, start, end, strand,
    note = ifelse(nchar(note) > 40, paste0(substr(note, 1, 37), "..."), note)
  )),
  caption = "Unified annotation table"
)
```

## Annotation map

```{r plot-annotation, fig.width=10, fig.height=2.6}
print(plot_annotation(annotation, q, meta))
```
